target.description: an explicit point for the leader to point at, in the callout's own space (paper inches on a sheet); prefer target_entity or target_anchor, which cannot miss

target_entity.description: what to point at, by id (find_entities and hit_test return them; reference elements are 'DESIGN:LN-004'). at.description: where along target_entity the leader TIP goes: start|mid|end or a fraction 0-1 (default mid) -- not where the text goes, which is position. From a sheet it runs along the part of the entity that sheet shows, so mid is always a point the reader can see

viewport.description: on a sheet, the viewport to see the target through (default: the first one that shows it)

position.description: where the text sits, clear of the geometry, in the callout's own space. content.description: the callout's text; \n starts a new line

height.description: text height in space units (feet in model, inches on sheets); defaults to the annotation scale in model space, 0.10 in on a sheet

landing.description: horizontal shoulder at the text (default 2.5 x height; 0 for none)
